target.purpose: Compile multi-sensor detections into bounded spatiotemporal envelopes without erasing evidence age, covariance, or residual unknown mass.
target.central_bottleneck: Point-like or confidence-renormalized tracks can hide stale evidence, correlated repeated observations, and spatial uncertainty behind a single confident projection.

invariants: empty evidence does not produce a track envelope
same-sensor observation multiplicity does not create independent confidence
older evidence contributes less support according to the configured half-life
covariance inputs must be finite, non-negative on the diagonal, and positive semidefinite
covariance expands spatial bounds instead of being discarded
residual unknown mass is preserved as first-class output
Python envelope identity is order-independent and binds exact evidence plus fusion policy
nonclaims: distinct sensor labels are not independently provenance-attested
